issues.explanation: Generated owner_seq SQL uses PHP ternary `role = "owner" ? 1 : NULL` with double quotes and VIRTUAL instead of CASE WHEN with single quotes and STORED, so the migration fails on both SQLite and MariaDB.
Policies, middleware, Dashboard and /home call `$user->entity_memberships()` which does not exist (User defines `memberships()`), so every authorization and tenant check throws.
Delete compares `$membership->role` (cast to UserRole enum) with `UserRole::Owner->value` string via ===, which is always false, so the owner's membership is never protected.
Lang files use flat keys `'entity.create_title'` instead of nested `entity => [create_title]`, so `__('ui.entity.create_title')` used in the Blade never resolves.

submit() calls uniqueSlug() once for the base slug then appends -2 manually instead of calling it on every attempt, and uniqueSlug() is just Str::slug() with no existence check for acme-corp then acme-corp-2.
Middleware only redirects or aborts and never resolves the session entity into an in-request tenant context as the task requires.
CreateEntity does Entity::create plus EntityMembership::create directly in the Livewire component instead of an app/Actions/* use case that authorizes inside the action.
Component validates via inline `$this->validate(['name' => ...])` instead of the project pattern `#[Validate]` plus `$this->validate()`.
Neither Livewire action calls `$this->authorize(...)` and HTTP routes/middleware use manual exists() checks instead of policies/gates, violating authorization-through-policies.
Custom `current_entity` middleware is not registered via `Livewire::addPersistentMiddleware`, so it silently stops applying on Livewire update requests.
Switcher Blade queries `auth()->user()->entities()->get()` and reads session in the view and the navbar counts memberships in the view instead of passing data from a controller/component.
The diff adds no Pest/PHPUnit tests, missing happy-path, validation-failure, unauthorized-call and tamper tests required for every feature and Livewire action.
EntityFactory derives slug via Str::slug(name) with only name uniqueness, so two distinct names can collide on slug without a uniqueness guarantee.
isDuplicateException() reads `$e->errorInfo[1]` directly and only accepts codes 19/1062, which is undefined on some drivers and cannot distinguish slug collisions from other unique violations.
Entity class header splits `extends \` across two lines and factories import unused HasFactory/Model, deviating from sibling style.
User model rewrites attribute-based Fillable/Hidden and casts() into legacy $fillable/$hidden/$casts properties with no task reason.

conventions.evidence: app/Livewire/Entity/CreateEntity.php:71 inline validate without #[Validate] and no Action class; resources/views/entity/switcher.blade.php:2 DB query in view; no Livewire::addPersistentMiddleware; manual exists() checks instead of $this->authorize/policy

readability.evidence: app/Models/Entity.php:182 `class Entity extends \` line break; database/factories/EntityFactory.php:4 unused imports; resources/views/entity/switcher.blade.php:2 PHP query block in Blade

requirements.evidence: database/migrations/...create_entity_memberships_table.php:15 invalid `GENERATED ALWAYS AS (role = "owner" ? 1 : NULL) VIRTUAL`; app/Policies/EntityPolicy.php:8 calls undefined `entity_memberships()` while User defines `memberships()`; lang/en/ui.php:17 flat 'entity.create_title' breaks __('ui.entity.create_title'); app/Livewire/Entity/CreateEntity.php:77 uniqueSlug only Str::slug called once

scope.evidence: app/Models/User.php:13 Fillable/Hidden attribute to property rewrite and AppServiceProvider comment removal serve no task requirement; no out-of-scope members/settings pages added

security.evidence: app/Policies/EntityMembershipPolicy.php:38 `$membership->role === UserRole::Owner->value` always false so owner delete allowed; app/Livewire/Entity/CreateEntity.php:71 no $this->authorize; no persistent middleware for current_entity

simplicity.evidence: Same `where('entity_id',...)->exists()` membership check duplicated in CurrentEntity.php:27, EntityPolicy, EntityMembershipPolicy, Dashboard.php:9 and web.php:35 instead of reusing membershipFor()/policies

tests.evidence: change.diff:1-880 contains no tests/* or *Test.php; no Pest/PHPUnit coverage including required unauthorized-call and tamper tests

review.summary: Adds entities, memberships, policies, tenant middleware, onboarding, dashboard, switcher and routes in the right shape, but the change cannot run: the owner_seq SQL is invalid and every auth check calls an undefined User method, plus translations, slug contract and owner-delete policy are wrong with no tests. Needs substantial rework before merging, so it is rejected.
